Recommendations for Improvement Display Clear Error Messages in Plain Language Use concise, user-friendly language (e.g., "Incorrect password. Please try again or reset your password."). Provide Solutions in Error Messages Suggest corrective actions, such as displaying password requirements or indicating valid input formats. Indicate Invalid Filter/Sorting Selections Show messages like "No results found. Try adjusting your filters." when an invalid selection is made. Add Warnings Before Critical Actions Include confirmation prompts before logging out or modifying settings. Use Visual Cues for Empty and Error States Display illustrations, icons, or messages for empty states (e.g., "No favorites added yet. Start exploring!").
